info.name: Tamagotchi Service
info.description: Every route of the Tamagotchi service (Lab 1), in the order the Runner should run them. Tokens are signed from the environment's mockJwtSecret, which must equal the service's MOCK_JWT_SECRET.

item.name: Setup (User Management)
item.description: Tokens come from User Management; nothing is signed locally.

exec: pm.test("starts at level 1 with 0 XP", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().level === 1 && pm.response.json().xp === 0).to.be.true);

item.name: List user A's Tamagotchis, one per page
Primary and secondary
item.description: One primary per user; secondaries are references, never copies.

exec: pm.test("it is the one just set", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().tamagotchiId === pm.collectionVariables.get('tamagotchiId')).to.be.true);

item.name: Error: choose someone else's Tamagotchi as primary
Attach it again with the same commandId
Combat types
item.description: The fixed advantage ring flame → nature → earth → electric → water → shadow → flame.

item.name: Internal routes
item.description: Called by Battle and Monster Raid; need X-Service-Token.

exec: pm.test("level 2 with 20 XP left", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().level === 2 && pm.response.json().xp === 20).to.be.true);

item.name: Grant the same XP command again

exec: pm.test("now owned by user B", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().ownerId === pm.collectionVariables.get('userBId')).to.be.true);

item.name: Primary of user A (service token only)

exec: pm.test("it is the creature set as primary", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().tamagotchiId === pm.collectionVariables.get('tamagotchiId')).to.be.true);

item.name: Error: primary of a user who has none
Attach a secondary reference for the holding check

exec: pm.test("a referenceId is returned", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().referenceId !== null).to.be.true);

item.name: Error: holding check for an unknown Tamagotchi
Events (mock of RabbitMQ)
item.description: Events other services would publish, delivered by hand.
